title: Rava Ze’ira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Arakhin 16b: Rava Ze’ira — and some say Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani — challenges it (Rabbi Elazar’s words): “They said even more than this — and you say…,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Arakhin 16b paragraph names Rava Ze’ira and gives Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani as an alternative attribution. The alternative is preserved without treating the names as one person.
